title: Events Options

fields.label: Posts Per Page

fields.instructions: Number of events to display per page on the Events archive page.

fields.label: Featured Posts Per Page
fields.name: events_featured_posts_per_page
fields.instructions: Number of featured events to display in the featured section.

fields.label: Hero Title
fields.name: events_hero_title
fields.instructions: Main title for the Events archive page hero section.

fields.label: Hero Title Line Two
fields.name: events_hero_title_line_two
fields.instructions: Optional second line for the hero title.

fields.label: Hero Subtitle
fields.name: events_hero_subtitle
fields.instructions: Subtitle text for the hero section.

fields.label: Hero Text
fields.name: events_hero_text
fields.instructions: Main description text for the hero section. Each line will create a new paragraph.

fields.label: Hero Button Text
fields.name: events_hero_button_text
fields.instructions: Text for the hero CTA button (optional).

fields.label: Hero Button Link
fields.name: events_hero_button_link
fields.instructions: URL for the hero CTA button.

fields.label: Hero Variation
fields.name: events_hero_variation
fields.instructions: Choose a style variation for the hero section.

fields.label: Full Height
fields.name: events_hero_full_height
fields.instructions: Make the hero section full viewport height with centered content.
